# SuspiciousBinaryOperation

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `SuspiciousBinaryOperationInspection`

Flags binary operations that are almost certainly not what the author meant:
`instanceof` against a trait, identical operands, `==` used as a statement,
`>=` typed instead of `=>` in an array, a comparison placed inside a call's
parentheses, negated comparisons on nullable values, `??` after a cast or
`!`, concatenation with an array literal, hard-coded booleans in `&&`/`||`,
and mixed `&&`/`||`/assignment precedence.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{6,8,9,10,11,13,14,17,19,20,21,22,24,29,36,37,38,39} [Before]
<?php
trait Loggable {}
interface Shape {}

function checks($obj, $p, $q, array $tags, ?int $limit) {
    $t1 = $obj instanceof Loggable;
    $t2 = $obj instanceof Shape;
    $s1 = $p->id === ($p->id);
    $s2 = count($tags) > count($tags);
    $p == $q;
    $map = ['enabled' >= true, $p >= 'x'];
    $out = [
        (bool)$p ?? 0,
        (!$q) ?? 1,
        $p ?? $q,
    ];
    $msg = 'tags: ' . ['a'];
    $ok = [
        $p and FALSE,
        $p || true,
        $p && \true,
        $p or null,
    ];
    if (!($limit < 10)) {}
}

class Quota {
    public function fits(string $who): bool {
        if (strlen($who >= 3)) {}
        if ($this->allow($who === 'root')) {}
        return true;
    }
    private function allow(bool $flag) { return $flag; }
}

if ($found = $left != $right) {}
if ($x || $y && $z) {}
if ($row = fetch() || $fallback) {}
if (!  $x >= $limit) {}
if (($x && $y) || $z) {}
$both = $x && $y;
if ((!$x) < $y) {}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
trait Loggable {}
interface Shape {}

function checks($obj, $p, $q, array $tags, ?int $limit) {
    $t1 = $obj instanceof Loggable;
    $t2 = $obj instanceof Shape;
    $s1 = $p->id === ($p->id);
    $s2 = count($tags) > count($tags);
    $p == $q;
    $map = ['enabled' >= true, $p >= 'x'];
    $out = [
        (bool)$p ?? 0,
        (!$q) ?? 1,
        $p ?? $q,
    ];
    $msg = 'tags: ' . ['a'];
    $ok = [
        $p and FALSE,
        $p || true,
        $p && \true,
        $p or null,
    ];
    if ($limit >= 10) {}
}

class Quota {
    public function fits(string $who): bool {
        if (strlen($who) >= 3) {}
        if ($this->allow($who === 'root')) {}
        return true;
    }
    private function allow(bool $flag) { return $flag; }
}

if ($found = ($left != $right)) {}
if ($x || ($y && $z)) {}
if ($row = (fetch() || $fallback)) {}
if ((!$x) >= $limit) {}
if (($x && $y) || $z) {}
$both = $x && $y;
if ((!$x) < $y) {}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 6: A trait is never an instanceof target; this is always false.</li>
<li>line 8: Both operands are the same.</li>
<li>line 9: Both operands are the same.</li>
<li>line 10: Comparison result is discarded; did you mean &#39;=&#39;?</li>
<li>line 11: Did you mean &#39;=&gt;&#39; for an array key?</li>
<li>line 13: &#39;(bool)$p&#39; is never null, so &#39;??&#39; is useless; add parentheses.</li>
<li>line 14: &#39;!$q&#39; is never null, so &#39;??&#39; is useless; add parentheses.</li>
<li>line 17: Concatenating an array literal makes no sense.</li>
<li>line 19: This constant decides the whole condition.</li>
<li>line 20: This constant decides the whole condition.</li>
<li>line 21: This constant has no effect in the condition.</li>
<li>line 22: This constant has no effect in the condition.</li>
<li>line 24: Null or false operands make this negated comparison misleading; use &#39;$limit &gt;= 10&#39;.</li>
<li>line 29: This comparison probably belongs outside the call parentheses.</li>
<li>line 36: Operator precedence is unclear here; add parentheses.</li>
<li>line 37: Operator precedence is unclear here; add parentheses.</li>
<li>line 38: Operator precedence is unclear here; add parentheses.</li>
<li>line 39: Operator precedence is unclear here; add parentheses.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VERIFY_CONSTANTS_IN_CONDITIONS` | bool | `true` | Enables D9. |
| `VERIFY_UNCLEAR_OPERATIONS_PRIORITIES` | bool | `true` | Enables D10. |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SuspiciousBinaryOperation": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "VERIFY_CONSTANTS_IN_CONDITIONS": true,
        "VERIFY_UNCLEAR_OPERATIONS_PRIORITIES": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SuspiciousBinaryOperation

/**
 * @noinspection SuspiciousBinaryOperationInspection
 */
```
